name: Unwip 0.43.32
body:
Fixes:
- Saving into a Dropbox or OneDrive folder on Windows: if the sync app is reading a file at the moment Unwip saves, Unwip now waits a moment and tries again instead of showing an error.
- Report a problem: opening it from the main screen no longer puts "[object PointerEvent]" in the box.
- Report a problem: error details no longer include your folder or book names. File paths are shortened to just the file's name (for example "…\project.json").
